# ACME Newsletter

## About
ACME Newsletter teaches indie SaaS founders how to grow without funding.
Founder: Jane. Subscribers: 12k.

## Voice
- Direct. Conversational. Sacrifice grammar for clarity.
- Write like texting a smart friend.
- Never: "leverage", "unlock", "supercharge"

## Audience
Bootstrapped SaaS founder, $0-$10k MRR, allergic to "growth hacking" jargon.
Lives on: LinkedIn, IndieHackers, Reddit r/saas.

## Rules
- NEVER commit .env or credentials
- Closed em-dashes only (word—word)
